maya: Quick follow-up from today's authz incident. We need owners and short timelines for remediation items. Can everyone pick one?

devon: I'll take token validation fixes (exp checks + replay guard). Small patch + unit tests + canary. Target: Wed EOD.

nina: I'll own audit coverage gaps and retention alignment. Will produce a short doc with samples. ETA: Fri.

igor: I'll update secrets rotation runbook and rotate any keys missing rotation metadata. Finish by Tue PM.

sam: I'll coordinate rollouts and create a JIRA template for recurring authz hygiene checks.

sec-oncall: I'll add a perm-drift alert rule (config diffs + key-age >45d) and post a playbook. ETA 48h.

maya: Action list: devon token fix (Wed), nina audit doc (Fri), igor rotate/runbook (Tue), sam rollout + jira (Tue/Wed), sec-oncall alert (48h). Add `postmortem:authz-2026` to subtasks.

devon: Note: canary showed a cache-invalidation race; adding a short lock + retry. Will post PR link when CI passes.

nina: Flagging compliance for retention changes in the doc.

igor: Found 2 keys missing rotation tag; will rotate and annotate.

sam: Scheduling a 30m handoff Wed 10:30 to review rollouts and watchers.

maya: Great. Drop quick updates here as you make progress and mark JIRA subtasks accordingly. :white_check_mark:
